Capture date: 2026-11-10 UTC. Owned synthetic sources only. Locale and timezone unmeasured. Captured for the receiver-member opaque-package project route (TestReceiverMemberProjectOpaquePackageCompileRoutes) after the namespace family's ruling 49.

Org: two fresh 30-day Developer scratch orgs with no namespace, no features and no installed package, created from an authorized campaign Dev Hub with existing scratch-HOME auth. The org holds no `missingns` namespace. No credentials, org identifiers, usernames or hub identities are recorded here.

Question: a project class references a nested type and a static member chain under a namespace the org does not have (`missingns.Parcel.Options options;` and `missingns.Parcel.Instance.save();`), with and without a same-spelled local class `Parcel`. Does the class compile, and does an unrelated test that only constructs it run, at API 62.0 and 67.0? The same question for each declaration position alone (instance field, static field in an @IsTest class, local variable, method parameter) combined with the static member call, and for the static call alone.

Route: each sources/<case>/ directory was deployed on its own, per API, with `sf project deploy start --source-dir force-app --dry-run --test-level RunSpecifiedTests --tests <test> --api-version <api>`, class metadata apiVersion and sourceApiVersion matching. `<test>` is ReceiverRunnerTest, or ReceiverProbe for the @IsTest-only cases (C07, C08, K04). org.tsv records one row per component failure (component, line:column, problem; `\n` stands for the newline in the problem text) or, for a deploy that compiled, one row per passing test method. C01 and C02 were deployed twice at each API; both observations are identical. Nothing persisted (check-only).

Result: every `missingns` case is a COMPILE_ERROR at 62.0 and 67.0 and runs no test. The declaration position gives `Invalid type: missingns.Parcel.Options` and the static call gives `Variable does not exist: missingns.Parcel.Instance`; when both are present both are reported. A same-spelled local `Parcel` changes nothing. The dependent runner class fails with `Dependent class is invalid and needs recompilation:` naming the first ReceiverProbe error.

Controls: K01 (no missingns reference) and K02 (a field and call of the local `Parcel`) compile and ReceiverRunnerTest.observe passes; K04 (an @IsTest class) compiles and its test passes. K01 and K02 report the deploy as Failed only because the dry run's coverage gate requires 75% coverage of the deployed non-test classes (codeCoverageWarnings, zero test failures). K03 (`System.NotATypePr173 options;`) is the reject control: `Invalid type: System.NotATypePr173`.

Deletion: `sf org delete scratch --no-prompt` returned status 0 for both capture aliases; the Dev Hub ScratchOrgInfo rows for both capture org names read Deleted (queried after the delete).
